verified_claims.claim: 紫杉醇在 *Taxus* 树皮中天然丰度约 0.004%
verified_claims.source_locator: PDF Page 1 'low natural abundance (~0.004% in Taxus bark)'
verified_claims.evidence: 原文短摘录见第 1 页左栏第二段。

verified_claims.claim: 35S 启动子驱动 T5αH 在 *N. benthamiana* 中产生至少 36 个氧化 taxadiene 产物
verified_claims.source_locator: PDF Page 2 'At least 36 oxidized products were observed by gas chromatography mass spectrometry'
verified_claims.evidence: 原文 Page 2 第二栏 'Results' 首段。

verified_claims.claim: TS + T5αH 在 *S. cerevisiae* 中染色体整合共表达产生 21 个氧化 taxadiene
verified_claims.source_locator: PDF Page 3 'we observed 21 oxidized taxadienes when TS and T5αH were chromosomally integrated and co-expressed in S. cerevisiae'
verified_claims.evidence: 原文 Page 3 第一栏 'Characterization of T5αH product profile' 段。

verified_claims.claim: T5αH 启动子由 35S 替换为 UBQ10/NOS 后，多官能团化产物占比由 68% → 37%/25%，taxadien-5α-ol 绝对量提升约 3 倍（Welch's t, P = 0.00022）
verified_claims.source_locator: PDF Page 4 'decreased significantly from 68% to 37% and 25% with UBQ10 or NOS promoters… three-fold increase in the absolute level of taxadien-5α-ol (2)'；Fig. 3c 标注 '~3x increase / P = 0.00022'
verified_claims.evidence: Page 4 第一栏末段与 Figure 3c 柱状图内嵌文本。

verified_claims.claim: 化合物 14 与 15 的大规模分离产率分别为 63 μg/g DW 和 42 μg/g DW
verified_claims.source_locator: PDF Page 6 'yield 14 and 15 in 63 ug/g dry weight (DW) and 42 ug/g DW yield, respectively'
verified_claims.evidence: Page 6 第一栏倒数第二段 NMR 分析前导句。

verified_claims.claim: 化合物 15（C-13 酮）为 *N. benthamiana* 内源酶对 14 的进一步氧化产物，而非 T13αH 直接产物
verified_claims.source_locator: PDF Page 6 'When 14 was fed into control *N. benthamiana* expressing GFP, it was partially oxidized to 15 (Supplementary Fig. 10). Therefore, we concluded that 15 results from oxidation by endogenous *N. benthamiana* enzymes rather than oxidation by T13αH.'

verified_claims.claim: T13αH 对 5α-acetoxytaxadiene (11) 的转化率仅为对 taxadien-5α-ol (2) 的 6%，对 5α-acetoxytaxadien-10β-ol (12) 无活性（参考文献 24）
verified_claims.source_locator: PDF Page 7 'recombinant T13αH oxidizes taxadien-5α-ol (2) efﬁciently, oxidizes 5α-acetoxytaxadiene (11) at 6% the conversion rate levels relative to 2, and has no activity on 5α-acetoxytaxadien-10β-ol (12)^24'
verified_claims.evidence: Page 7 第一栏 Discussion 前段。
